subject.title: fix(polls): add default maximum poll option count

question: Should Matrix polls with more than 20 supplied answers be truncated to the MSC3381 maximum, or should OpenClaw intentionally fail the send before delivery?
rationale: The current adapter contract exposes only a rejecting maximum, while the Matrix protocol describes a 20-answer truncation rule and current OpenClaw behavior is permissive; choosing between those user-visible behaviors is an interoperability policy decision.

options.title: Truncate at the Matrix boundary
options.body: Replace the rejecting adapter cap with a Matrix-owned truncation path that sends the first 20 answers and keeps outbound results consistent.

options.title: Adopt fail-closed validation
options.body: Keep the 20-answer error only after a Matrix owner accepts that existing oversized poll calls must stop sending and the upgrade behavior is documented and proven.

options.title: Pause the change
options.body: Leave current permissive behavior in place until the Matrix interoperability policy and its supported implementation shape are decided.

recommendation.title: Truncate at the Matrix boundary
recommendation.body: Replace the rejecting adapter cap with a Matrix-owned truncation path that sends the first 20 answers and keeps outbound results consistent.
